product.description: Monoprice™Commercial Series Column Mount for Portrait and Landscape Displays, Fits 32" to 65" TVsThe Monoprice Commercial Series Column Mount for Landscape or Portrait Displays is a professional column-mounted solution for installing a single large display in landscape or portrait orientation.
